prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single original square Android launcher icon for AICEcho, an independent NFC-F card-management and emulation app.
Primary request: express "the original card and its echo": the same card identity responding from a new device, with local ownership and continuity.
Scene/backdrop: a truly flat solid deep pine-green background, full bleed.
Subject: one simple warm-ivory rounded rectangular card in the foreground, gently tilted. Two bright jade-mint outline echoes of exactly that card silhouette unfold from behind it toward the upper right, with even spacing and rounded ends. The echoes should read as a repeated contour or resonance of the original card, not a stack of three separate bank cards. Create an elegant unified mark with a strong original-card silhouette and an unmistakable echo rhythm. No internal card markings.
Style/medium: clean, precise, minimal flat vector-style icon, balanced negative space, crisp geometry, excellent readability at small launcher sizes.
Color palette: deep pine green, warm ivory, jade mint; solid flat colors only.
Composition/framing: single centered symbol occupying the middle 60 percent of the square; generous safe space on every edge. Full-bleed square background, not a pre-rounded tile. Exactly one icon, no mockup, no presentation board.
Text: none.
Constraints: no existing brands or logos, no official contactless symbol, no generic Wi-Fi arcs, no stars, no letters or numbers, no padlock, no chip, no gradient, no shadow, no texture, no glossy 3D, no tiny details. Original independent branding for AICEcho.
